name: Scout
description: Scout is a self-hosted network monitor with distributed agents, durable discovery, and host telemetry.

notes.text: Open http://<IP>:8080 after installation. Read the one-time setup token with: scout setup-token
Scout stores SQLite, authentication keys, credential keys, and control-signing keys together in the scout-data Docker volume. Include that volume in backups.
This helper exposes Scout over plain HTTP on port 8080. Use it only on a trusted network or put a TLS reverse proxy in front of it before remote access.
